feedback_interpretation: The previous measurements reinforced three needs: condition response is scaffold-specific, V2 tails can fail independently of V1, and loading effects can interact with functional-group environment. The new batch therefore combines broad-width upper-tail rows with low-strength and narrow-width anchors. Candidate widths and CW distances are used as model-behavior signals only; they are not treated as measured errors.
batch_rationale: This batch covers high- and low-strength PE, EA, and DCM conditions across aldehydes, ketones, esters, alcohols, nitriles, sulfur-containing graphs, halogenated aromatics, donor-containing compounds, and fused structures. The broad predicted-width rows target upper-tail and remote-space repair, while the narrower anchors improve local interpolation and calibrate early-elution floors. The set also includes unusual loading-solvent volumes and sample amounts, giving the retrained model information about condition and loading interactions that can generalize across the Row-distribution.
